title: TWZRD loop proof: claim checked before, Solana settlement witnessed after
framing: Self-funded house run (0.0022 USDC total, from TWZRD's proof-payer wallet 64NsKhbNGZCEj6sgTtjzscfuXSZSEpD1GoBXbT45yv4J). Proves mechanics end to end, not market demand.

blocked_attempt.what_happened: the gate refused fail-closed because its preflight call to intel timed out after 2000 ms; nothing was signed; a retry with the same default timeout passed (measured preflight latency right after: 0.15-0.32 s)

what_this_does_and_does_not_show: Shows: a free pre-spend check produced a verdict on the exact 402 requirement before any signer ran; a real USDC payment settled on Solana mainnet through the seller's facilitator; the seller returned 200; the settlement is finalized on chain and was recorded by TWZRD's x402 ingest within ~4 s.

Does not show: outside demand (the payer is TWZRD's own wallet); delivery quality beyond HTTP 200 and a body digest; a TWZRD-signed receipt about the settlement (the hosted by-tx witness covers only TWZRD-facilitated settlements, so for a third-party seller the chain itself plus the ingest row is the witness).
The hosted readiness card's maximum_recommended_spend_usdc for each resource equalled its listed price (0.0012 and 0.001); the gate's per-call cap was 0.01.
records: one JSON per run, kept by TWZRD; this file is the summary
